source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeCacheExceptionTypenameEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Cache.BulkApiKeysLimitExceededException bulkEx = new Cache.BulkApiKeysLimitExceededException('bulk'); System.assertEquals('Cache.BulkApiKeysLimitExceededException', bulkEx.getTypeName()); Cache.CacheBuilderExecutionException builderEx = new Cache.CacheBuilderExecutionException('builder'); System.assertEquals('Cache.CacheBuilderExecutionException', builderEx.getTypeName()); Cache.CacheException cacheEx = new Cache.CacheException('cache'); System.assertEquals('Cache.CacheException', cacheEx.getTypeName()); Cache.ExecutionException executionEx = new Cache.ExecutionException('execution'); System.assertEquals('Cache.ExecutionException', executionEx.getTypeName()); Cache.InvalidCacheBuilderException invalidBuilderEx = new Cache.InvalidCacheBuilderException('invalid builder'); System.assertEquals('Cache.InvalidCacheBuilderException', invalidBuilderEx.getTypeName()); Cache.InvalidParamException paramEx = new Cache.InvalidParamException('param'); System.assertEquals('Cache.InvalidParamException', paramEx.getTypeName()); Cache.ItemSizeLimitExceededException itemEx = new Cache.ItemSizeLimitExceededException('item'); System.assertEquals('Cache.ItemSizeLimitExceededException', itemEx.getTypeName()); Cache.OrgCacheException orgEx = new Cache.OrgCacheException('org'); System.assertEquals('Cache.OrgCacheException', orgEx.getTypeName()); Cache.PlatformCacheInvalidOperationException invalidOperationEx = new Cache.PlatformCacheInvalidOperationException('operation'); System.assertEquals('Cache.PlatformCacheInvalidOperationException', invalidOperationEx.getTypeName()); Cache.SessionCacheException sessionEx = new Cache.SessionCacheException('session'); System.assertEquals('Cache.SessionCacheException', sessionEx.getTypeName()); Cache.SessionCacheNoSessionException noSessionEx = new Cache.SessionCacheNoSessionException('no session'); System.assertEquals('Cache.SessionCacheNoSessionException', noSessionEx.getTypeName()); Cache.UnsupportedOperationException unsupportedEx = new Cache.UnsupportedOperationException('unsupported'); System.assertEquals('Cache.UnsupportedOperationException', unsupportedEx.getTypeName()); } }
